entry.name: text.codebox
entry.description: The dict.codebox object is a UI object for display and editing of text, optionally backed by a file on disk. Clicking on the hammer icon will output the text as a string and optionally write the file back to disk (autowrite must be enabled). Beware of losing work when enabling autowrite. It can use a syntax highlighting style (.js, .json, ,jxs, .coll, .genexpr, .lua, or .cpp)

attributes.name: autowatch
attributes.digest: Auto-Load File When Changed
attributes.description: Automatically reload the text file when it is changed outside of Max.

attributes.name: autowrite
attributes.digest: Auto-Write File When Changed
attributes.description: Automatically write the contents of the text editor to the specified file when the codebox contents are changed. WARNING: enabling this attribute will cause the file contents to be overwritten and you may lose data.
